found.speaker: Dov Carrow
found.text: Don't, I have nothing, I... oh. You are from Wrackmouth. Bram sent you. Of course he did.

found2.speaker: Dov Carrow
found2.text: The mule bolted at dusk. Over the rise there is smoke, my cousin's farm, and in the fog above it, wings. Wings as wide as a barn. I am not driving this road again. Take him my tally stick so he knows I am alive.

found3.speaker: Dov Carrow
found3.text: And tell him I will pay for the cart. Later. When I stop shaking.

after.speaker: Dov Carrow
after.text: Go. Tell Bram. And do not look up when you pass that ridge.

default.speaker: Dov Carrow
default.text: Keep walking, friend. Nothing to see here but a man and a ditch.
